title: Dr. Ruthie Bolton, ATHENA Global Award recipient
ig:

title: Keynote Panel: Leading Through Turbulence
ig:
Four women who lead airports. One conversation about leading when the pressure rises.

Keynote panel “Leading Through Turbulence: Courage, Clarity, and Calm When the Pressure Rises”
Friday, January 29, 9:00 AM

With Nicole Noll-Williams (Capital Region Airport Authority), Melissa Cooper (Kansas City International Airport), Charlene Reynolds (John Wayne Airport) and Dominique Ranieri (West Virginia International Yeager Airport).

Early Bird pricing from $545 ends November 15.
Tickets: conference.athenainternational.org
